transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! Yes, I have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust, and sunglasses outside can help. But if it is severe, or you have bright light pain with a red, painful eye, that is not normal and we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?
